subject: english
title: Verb Engine — Actions, BE, Time and Helpers
subtitle: The partner deck to Noun Stadium. 8 stations: the engine idea, the three word teams, BE verbs, the -s rule, now vs every day, the past, word order, and helpers. 31 slides, 11 drills.

content: Explain that every English sentence needs a WHO and an ENGINE, and find the verb in any sentence — including quiet verbs and BE.
Separate nouns, verbs, and describing words using the three test frames (a/the ___, I can ___, very ___), including word families like win / winner / windy.
Choose between the two time clocks — a habit every day versus something happening right now — and rewind a sentence into the past.
language: Use am, is, and are correctly and never omit the BE verb, the highest-frequency Japanese-speaker error.
Add the third-person -s with the right spelling machine (+s, +es, consonant + y → -ies), avoiding the vowel-before-y trap, and produce have → has.

Build be + ing and regular -ed forms, produce ten irregular past rebels, keep the verb in the middle of the sentence, and use Do / Does / Did for questions and negatives with only one ending in the sentence.
